pages.text: At first the country felt empty. Now the pauses between sounds feel occupied.
pages.title: Awareness
An answering pulse
pages.text: Awareness is a per-dimension pressure. Time spent there and expedition activity can raise it; higher pressure can strengthen the hordes. The next page reports this dimension's current reading.

pages.title: An answering pulse
pages.text: Another dimension has its own state. Do not judge its safety by the quiet of your home.
